top_categories.workout_context: 172 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
17,618ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
17,618ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
102ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.

L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive's paved mountain roads through the Massif Central forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 172 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 172 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Train it until it feels boring.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 17,618ft of climbing on paved mountain roads through the Massif Central does to your power file on race day.
172 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Low-cadence force work for 17,618ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Fueling for 172 miles requires a practiced plan matched to expected duration, intensity, tolerance, and the course's confirmed feed or commercial resupply options. Rehearse the plan on long rides, begin early, carry redundant fuel, and avoid treating a fixed total-calorie estimate as a race prescription.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Over Under to prepare you for 172 miles of paved mountain roads through the massif central in Saint-Félicien, Ardèche, France.
